stemMarkdown: In a survey of 260 people, 169 like tea and 117 like coffee, while 23 like neither. How many like both tea and coffee?
solutionMarkdown: People liking at least one drink: $260 - 23 = 237$. By inclusion-exclusion, $|A \cup B| = |A| + |B| - |A \cap B|$, so $|A \cap B| = 169 + 117 - 237 = 49$.
